notes.title: To all players/customers : Thanks for the great year!
notes.content:
Just wanted to say thanks to you guys for playing my game(s) and allowing me to keep doing what I love. In 2015, I released my first 2 games on Steam and couldn't be any happier with how it turned out. I'm currently working on a FPS (Trigger Spree) and a 3D platformer (Animal Galaxy) and excited to share more progress and info in the coming months. I'll be posting Greenlight pages for both games soon to gauge community interest on them. ːsquirrel_orangeː ːdog_huskyː

I may add some new levels and features to Squirreltopia in time. And Im working on porting it to Mac and Linux.

--SD

notes.title: Update 1.015 Live (fixed small issues and added options + HUD improve)
notes.content:
-HUD now has shadows for easier reading & better look

-Fixed a few tile graphical errors

-Added a few bomb-blocks to level 1-2 to introduce players to the mechanic earlier

-Screenshot bug fixed where only F12 would work

-Added window/fullscreen option to menu


As always,  thanks for playing, and have fun! ːsquirrel_orangeː

notes.title: Youtube / Twitch Promotion (if you have a channel, please read!)
notes.content:
I am currently looking for more youtubers (and/or streamers) to play the game. If you have a decent amount of subs, I can give out some keys for the game if you make a video for your channel (more subs = more keys). 

You can email me at surrealdistractions.contact@gmail.com

There has been a lot of people playing the game on YouTube, and I hope to see more! ːsquirrel_orangeː

Thanks!
